SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%CI_%' ORDER BY START_DATETIME DESC

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%CI_%' ORDER BY CREATE_DATETIME DESC

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_ERROR_DTL WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%CI_%' ORDER BY CREATE_DATETIME DESC

select * from om.om_Tasks where  TASK_NAME LIKE '%CCD_CBCEXTXLGP%'

SELECT * FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT

DEPOSIT_FACT
SELECT 
OTD.*,OTR.*
FROM OM.om_task_dependency OTD
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
ON 
OTD.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
AND PROCESS_DATE='2023-08-31'
WHERE DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_CI_CCD_TRAN_AUTH_RETAIL%' 


delete from [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] where TASK_NAME='TSK_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING' 

INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]
(DEPENDENCY_ID, TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))+ (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID),0) FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]) , TASK_NAME,'TSK_CI_CARDS_RETAIL' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME

select least(crm_date,deposits_date,loans_date,ccd_date,try_date,tru_date) fulldate from eds.eds_ctl
